title: Vox — Skill Activation
description: Skill activation by trigger_source and surface. skill_id_hash values are salted-SHA256 — never raw ids.

targets.rawSql: SELECT day, trigger_source, sum(cnt) AS total FROM mv_skill_activation WHERE day >= today() - 30 GROUP BY day, trigger_source HAVING total >= 20 ORDER BY day

SELECT surface, countIf(accepted = 1) AS accepted_cnt, countIf(accepted = 0) AS rejected_cnt, round(100.0 * countIf(accepted = 1) / count(), 1) AS accept_pct FROM mv_skill_activation WHERE day >= today() - 30 GROUP BY surface HAVING count() >= 20
